_readme: Hand-entered opening hours, for venues that do not publish machine-readable ones.
Why this file exists: scripts/scrapeHours.ts reads schema.org markup from venue
websites, and for Milan it returns nothing at all — 13 of 19 sites publish no hours
markup, 4 return HTTP 403 to our crawler, 2 are unreachable. Run it yourself with
`npm run hours:scrape -- --dry` to see the current picture.
Nothing in here is guessed. Every entry must be copied from the venue's own site or
signage, and `source` must be the URL you copied it from. A venue absent from this
file simply shows no hours in the app, which is the correct outcome — a wrong
'Open now' sends someone across the city to a locked door.
name    must match the venue name in scripts/venues.ts exactly
hours   one entry per weekday that has opening hours; omit closed days entirely
two entries for the same day express a lunch closure
source  the page the hours were read from
closed  optional YYYY-MM-DD dates the venue is exceptionally shut
